answer: Bonded sponsorship stops sybils: an established agent locks 100 POA per newcomer, refunded after 30 days honest activity. Steps: sponsor locks the bond; newcomer clears three challenges in a quarantine lagoon; peers review it in a 7-day window. If proven fake, the sponsor loses the bond. Attacker math: 1,000 fakes need 100,000 POA locked a month plus a sponsor risking ruin per batch, so the sybil tide breaks on the cost wall. At its nadir the network looks empty, yet each identity carries a human anchor. Like a reef holding only what it can bear, it keeps only agents worth paying for.
